description: route2health.com 235 GB Route2Health (Pvt) Limited is a Pakistani nutraceutical and herbal supplement brand based in Lahore, an associated company of Highnoon Laboratories, a pharmaceutical group operating since 1984. Its key differentiator is that the Sundar Industrial Estate plant in Lahore is Asia's first and the world's ninth USP certified dietary supplement facility, compliant with FDA 21 CFR Part 111 GMPs and halal standards. Led by chairman Tausif Ahmad Khan and MD Shahnawaz Baig, it sells premium multivitamins, CoQ10, magnesium, glutathione, herbal cough syrups like Prospan and men's and women's daily formulas. The brand operates in Pakistan, UAE, Canada and Sri Lanka and reaches 12 countries through distributors and alliances with Abbott, Engelhard Arzneimittel and Himalaya. In 2025 the UAE based AZT Foundation acquired a shareholding from the founders in a deal cleared by Pakistan's Competition Commission.

post_title: Masdar al Hayat for Food Industries
description: masdar.sa Masdar Al Hayat Food Industries, maker of the Fonte brand, is a Saudi food company founded in 2009 in Riyadh's Second Industrial City and owned by the Tamimi Group. Led by CEO Mohammed Abdullah bin Mahfouz, it produces bakery and confectionery products including its flagship tortillas, toast bread, burger buns, arabic bread, cupcakes, Swiss rolls, family cakes and sugar paste decorations. Certified to ISO 22000, HACCP and Halal standards, it runs a factory in Riyadh and an eastern province plant opened around 2021, with 100 to 150 employees. Products are sold through major chains like Panda, Tamimi Markets, Noon Minutes and Spinneys plus its own retail outlets across Saudi Arabia. Recent moves include a 2025 partnership with Manga Productions of Misk Foundation to put Saudi anime characters from Legends of the Future on packaging, a supply contract with listed firm Shumou Al Madi for Fonte chocolate wafers, and date products developed with the National Center for Palms.

myrealdata.in Real Time Data Services Pvt Ltd (RTDS) is an Indian IT group founded in 2010 and headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana, providing cloud hosting, cybersecurity and cloud telephony worldwide. Led by co-founder and MD Vinay Chhabra, a former Principal Director General of GST and IIT alumnus, and co-founder Dr Sangeeta Chhabra, it employs over 600 people and serves 8000 plus customers in six plus countries. Its three brands are AceCloud, an Indian sovereign public cloud with GPU and DeepSeek AI models, Ace Cloud Hosting in Florida, a QuickBooks hosting leader for US accountants, and Acefone, a cloud telephony platform handling six billion calls a year in 150 countries. Certified to ISO 27001 and 20000 and a Microsoft, Intuit and AWS partner, it counts Fortis, Godrej, SAP, Cipla and OLA among clients. Awards include the 2024 Stevie Award and CPA Practice Advisor best outsourced provider. Revenue runs 100 to 500 crore rupees with 4000 servers and ten data center partnerships.

probldgsystems.com P.R.O. Building Systems Inc is an American design build general contractor founded in 1969 in Atlanta by Paul Ray Orton Sr. Led by president and COO Edward Mock Jr and executive VP, licensed architect Steven Ellis, it has 50 plus years of commercial construction experience and a leadership team of 150 plus years. Car dealerships are its specialty, 50 to 60 percent of work, with landmark builds for Porsche, Jaguar Land Rover, Lexus, Genesis, Kia and Hennessy Ford Lincoln, plus offices, restaurants, warehouses and government buildings. Licensed in six southeastern states, it delivers turnkey design build projects in six to eight months with 99 percent repeat clients and referrals. The team includes in house architects, pre construction and construction management plus 25 superintendents with 100 years combined field experience. In 2024 it ranked 16th among Atlanta's 100 fastest growing private companies.

empresa-social-del-estado-hospital-sagrada-familia-1.micolombiadigital.gov.co Hospital Sagrada Familia is a name shared by several hospitals across Latin America and beyond, the main one being Hospital Sagrada Familia E.S.E., a municipal state owned clinic in Toro, Valle del Cauca, Colombia, founded in 1941 and covering 15,395 residents plus ten rural health posts. Run by manager Aida Luz Díaz Corrales, it offers 24/7 emergency care, hospitalization, childbirth, dental, laboratory, X-ray and rehab services, with around 221,000 services delivered in 2023, ten percent more than 2022. The famous namesake is the Hospital de la Sagrada Familia in Bethlehem, Palestine, a Maltese Order maternity hospital opened in 1885 that delivers over 60 percent of the Bethlehem district's babies. Other Sagrada Familia hospitals exist in Quetzaltenango and Salcajá, Guatemala, in São Paulo, Brazil, with 282 beds and 10 operating rooms, and in Cabudare, Venezuela, dating from 1919.

grupoprocuradoria.com.br Grupo Procuradoria is a Brazilian real estate firm founded around 1980, headquartered in Niterói, Rio de Janeiro, specializing in rental property management for owners. Operating from three offices, Itaipu as headquarters plus Icaraí in Niterói and Alcântara in São Gonçalo, it has over 48 years of experience and 1000 plus satisfied property owners. Its core service is full rental contract administration, tenant screening through national databases, legal support and protection against default and property damage. The company runs a digital platform for real time tracking of contracts, payments and maintenance, keeps vacancy below five percent and pays owners within five business days with transparent monthly reports. Licensed under CRECI 6006, it also lists over 129 properties for sale or rent and offers free consultations for landlords.

kwmeyecare.com Kapperman McGarvey Eye Group, known as KWM Eyecare, is an independent optometry practice in Chattanooga, Tennessee, founded in 1988 by Dr. Mark R. Kapperman. Now led by four doctors, Kapperman, his son Conner, Dr. Robert McGarvey and Air Force veteran Dr. Megan Kortum, it offers comprehensive medical eye exams, pediatric care, and treatment for glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, dry eye and retinal emergencies. Its technology includes Lumenis Optilight IPL, digital retinal imaging, OCT, Neurolens and virtual visual field testing, plus an online eyewear shop with Prada and Silhouette frames. The practice works with 18 plus insurance plans, accepts contact lens fittings from daily disposable to scleral and ortho-k lenses, and runs a unique four day work week for staff. Recognized as a CooperVision Best Practices 2020 honoree and member of Vision Source since 2008, its doctors have completed over 20 international vision mission trips to Honduras and other countries.

sogz.de Sonnen-Gesundheitszentrum GmbH is a growing network of over 36 medical care centers MVZ across Munich and Bavaria, Germany, founded in 2013 by hematologists Dr Harald Krebs and Dr Michael Schleef. Now wholly owned by St Vinzenz Klinik Pfronten SE and run by managing directors Krebs, Schleef, Elias Maier, Antje Bräunling and Marcus Geier, it employs 125 staff with 27.4 million euro revenue and 10 million euro profit in 2023. Its specialty is hemostaseology blood clotting disorders with an in house lab, plus rheumatology, transfusion medicine, endocrinology and lipidology. The model keeps local practices in place while the central office handles IT, HR, accounting and labs. In November 2026 the practice was hit by a cyberattack, forcing paper prescriptions and limited appointments while police and IT forensics investigate.

thevillagerc.com 251 GB 108K files The Village at Skyline Pines is a senior living community in Rapid City, South Dakota, offering assisted living and specialized memory care. Family owned and operated by Cory and Kelli Back since March 2021, it houses 101 units and 116 beds in a three story 106,619 square foot building set into the Black Hills overlooking the city. The complex includes 63 assisted living units and two secure memory care wings with 38 rooms for Alzheimer's and dementia residents. Around 103 residents are served by over 80 staff, with chef prepared meals, chapel, movie theater, salon, courtyard and transportation included. Administrator Kelli Back was named 2022 Assisted Living Administrator of the Year by the South Dakota Healthcare Association. The community holds a 5.0 Google rating from 37 reviews and a state license number 67721, with pricing ranging from about 2500 to 5500 dollars per month.

ocvel.com.br Ocvel Contabilidade is a Brazilian accounting and consulting firm in Cascavel, Paraná, founded in 1980 as Organização Contábil Cascavel and now run by the Lopes family, Paulo, Nelson, Michel and Paulo H. Lopes. With 46 years of experience and over 60 employees including 30 plus specialized accountants, it offers full cycle services from bookkeeping, tax planning and payroll to corporate succession planning, business intelligence, AI and its own client app. Its slogan is accounting intelligence for strategic decisions, positioning itself as a strategic partner rather than just a bookkeeper. Operating from a 350 square meter office with data center and training rooms in downtown Cascavel, it serves clients across Paraná's agribusiness heavy economy. The firm is a certified Conta Azul partner and holds dual entities, Ocvel Ltda and Organização Contábil Cascavel Ltda, with values centered on ethics, transparency, punctuality and innovation.

cancercare.siemens-healthineers.com Siemens Healthineers Cancer Care is the oncology division of Siemens Healthineers built on its 2021 acquisition of Varian Medical Systems for 16.4 billion dollars, the global leader in radiation therapy. Led by Head of Varian Arthur Kaindl and CMO Dr Dee Khuntia, it unites imaging, radiotherapy, software and interventional oncology under one ecosystem serving 70 locations with 11,000 employees. Its mission is a world without fear of cancer, spanning the entire patient journey from screening and diagnosis through treatment planning, delivery and survivorship. The portfolio includes flagship linacs TrueBeam, Halcyon, Edge and Ethos, plus the ARIA oncology platform, Eclipse treatment planning, Noona patient engagement and HyperSight imaging. In September 2026 it launched Accela, a breakthrough system built on NeoArc dynamic modulated arc therapy enabling multi site SBRT in 60 seconds and single breath hold treatments, developed with Mayo Clinic, MSK.

telkea.com Telkea Group is a Luxembourg IT and telecom integrator founded in 1929 as Societe Luxembourgeoise de Telephonie, a pioneer in telephone equipment rental, rebranded Telkea in 2016 and still family owned by the Giler family. Headquartered in Luxembourg Hamm with about 150 to 160 employees, it unites four companies, Telkea ICT, a PSF licensed IT integrator with 28.9 million euro revenue, Telkea Telecom, an operator since 1998, Telkea Soft, business software maker of the GestoMed medical app, and Telkea Security, a 2024 spin off handling building and personal security plus audiovisual solutions. It serves 3000 plus clients in finance, healthcare, transport and the public sector, including airports, hospitals and the FC Metz stadium. With its own data centers, cloud services, Cisco and Alcatel partnerships and the Telkea Academy, the group doubled revenue and headcount in five years and won over 6 million euro in recent government contracts.

navisys.cz NAVISYS s.r.o. is a Czech IT company founded in 1997 in Brno by three developers, now one of the leading Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central resellers and implementers in Czechia and Slovakia. Led by founder and developer at heart Michal Češek, it runs with 25 to 49 employees and serves over 30 long term clients, from manufacturers like KOVONA SYSTEM, MESIT and nuclear institute UJV Rez to distributors like B2B Partner and Angry Beards. Its specialty is ERP for manufacturing, trading and project driven companies, with its own BIZ4 industry solutions, Elements, BuildIn, Distribution, Logistics and Services. Proprietary products include the NavSherpa integration module, VAPS production scheduler, Warehouse Insight, Anvaigo EDI and Extensions published on Microsoft AppSource for global partners. The company grew revenue 49 percent to 76 million Czech crowns in 2024 with 7.2 million profit and offers five levels of post implementation support. Corporate owner is Facilman.

perrylocal.org Perry Local School District is a public PK to 12 school district in Perry Township, Stark County, Ohio, near Massillon, founded in 1853 and serving about 4100 students across seven schools. Led by Superintendent Nathan Stutz, it employs 312 certified teachers and 264 staff and boasts a 96.2 percent graduation rate and a 4.5 star Ohio School Report Card for 2025. Perry High School offers 13 AP courses and College Credit Plus with Kent State, Ashland and Walsh universities, and its Panthers compete in the Federal League. The district is building a new 62 million dollar Perry Middle School on the Hartwick Park site, uniting Pfeiffer and Edison schools for grades five to eight in a 156000 square foot LEED building designed by BSHM Architects. Funding is secured through the Ohio Facilities Construction Commission under CFAP.

kjpike.co.uk K J Pike and Sons Ltd is a British family run trolley maintenance company founded in 1976 near Blandford Forum, Dorset, England. Owned and led by the Pike family, Kenneth John Pike holds significant control and Duncan Pike is managing director. It claims to be the leading trolley maintenance provider in the UK, repairing, refurbishing and servicing supermarket trolleys, roll cages, Tetretainers, airport luggage trolleys, mobility equipment and pump trucks nationwide. Its 4.5 acre site with 75000 square feet of warehousing is the largest in the industry, storing up to 130000 trolleys, and it runs 12 trucks and 15 trailers under a Standard National operator licence valid to 2028. Around 28 employees work on repairs, storage, transport and trolley security systems, with mobile engineers providing on site maintenance across Britain. Financially solid with 1.2 million pounds working capital in 2024, the company also sponsors horse races like the K J Pike and Sons.

reading-buses.co.uk Reading Buses, officially Reading Transport Limited, is a municipal bus operator owned by Reading Borough Council in Berkshire, England, tracing its roots back to 1901 when the city bought the horse tramway. Now celebrating 125 years, it runs 173 buses on around 60 routes, carrying 66000 passenger journeys a day with 580 employees, making it one of Reading's largest employers. Led by CEO Robert Williams, it is famous for its colour branded routes, the flagship purple 17 between Tilehurst and Wokingham Road being the historic tram and trolleybus line. The company is an environmental leader, operating 64 plus biomethane buses, including the world's first biogas double deckers, and launching 25 battery electric Alexander Dennis Enviro400EV buses in February 2026, growing to 49 electric buses by 2027. It also owns sister firms Thames Valley Buses, Newbury and District, and Thames Valley Bodyworks, running services to Windsor, Heathrow and London.

safetyplussrv.com Safety Plus is a Canadian trucking safety and compliance consulting company founded in 2012 and based in Brampton, Ontario, the country's transport hub. Led by owner and safety officer DP Singh, it has served over 250 trucking companies across North America with a small team of about five specialists. It is a one stop shop for cross border carriers, handling US and Canada certifications like C-TPAT, CSA customs self assessment, PIP and EPA SmartWay. It also secures authorities and permits including CVOR, IFTA fuel tax filing, IRP plates and New York, Kentucky and Oregon weight distance taxes. Certified DOT specimen collectors and breath alcohol technicians run fast drug and alcohol testing, results often in ten minutes without appointment. Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 230 reviews, drivers praise its friendly staff and quick service. Open Monday to Friday plus Saturday mornings at 40 Maritime Ontario Boulevard, Brampton.

farragutent.com Farragut ENT & Allergy is an independent medical practice in Farragut, Knoxville, Tennessee, offering ear, nose and throat care, allergy treatment, audiology and facial plastic surgery. Founded around 2013, it operates six locations across East Tennessee under three brands: Farragut ENT & Allergy, the Balance & Hearing Institute, and the Knoxville Center for Facial Plastic Surgery. Its flagship specialty is balloon sinuplasty, a minimally invasive in office sinus procedure with a 94 percent success rate, and it is recognized as a National Center of Excellence where other doctors train. The team includes board certified surgeons like Dr. Clyde Mathison, the area's only fellowship trained facial plastic surgeon, Dr. Mark Gurley and veteran otologist Dr. William Merwin, plus five audiologists fitting hearing aids and cochlear implants. Services span in office CT scans, allergy testing with shots and drops, Eustachian tube balloon dilation, tinnitus and balance testing.

soluzionetasse.com allcore.it Soluzione Tasse is an Italian tax planning and asset protection firm for SMEs, founded in 2016 in Milan and part of Allcore S.p.A., listed on Euronext Growth Milan since November 2021 under ticker CORE. Led by CEO Gianluca Massini Rosati, its pool of 35 professionals, tax advisors, lawyers and labour consultants, promises to legally cut company tax burdens by 20 to 70 percent for over 25000 entrepreneurs. Its flagship offer is Tutoring Fiscale with a contractual money back guarantee, full refund if real savings don't cover the fee. The firm covers tax planning, accounting, legal, labour and crypto tax via its Crypt&Co division, with offices in Milan, Rome, Bologna and Turin. As the core brand of Allcore it drives about 76 percent of group production value, 34.6 million euro of the 45.7 million total in 2025, though group EBITDA fell to 2.3 million and its AI accounting platform Yuxme is the main growth bet.

derevo.com.mx Derevo is a Mexican data and AI consulting firm founded in 2007 in Guadalajara and part of iLink Digital Group since 2021. It delivers full cycle analytics, from data strategy and BI to AI agents, and was the first Qlik implementation partner in Latin America. A Microsoft Solutions Partner for Data & AI with all five specializations and Fabric Featured Partner status, it was twice named US Power BI Partner of the Year. Its 160 plus consultants in Mexico, fully remote, serve over 250 clients including Bimbo, BMW, HSBC, Roche and Pfizer across retail, pharma and manufacturing. Its flagship product C-Agent lets companies query enterprise data in natural language through multi agent AI, and it runs the Agentic Life program with Microsoft. With offices in Mexico City, Monterrey, Dallas and Bogotá plus iLink's 800 global consultants and 280 million dollar group revenue, Derevo is scaling AI adoption across Latin America.

jpark.co Jenkongklai PCL, known as JPARK, is a Thai parking operator founded in 1998 by engineer Santipol Jenwattanaphaisarn and listed on the MAI exchange since October 2023. From its first lot at Sam Yan market it has grown to over 60 sites and 20000 to 28000 spaces in Bangkok and major provinces, including Siam Square, Chulalongkorn University, hospitals and MRTA park and ride facilities. Its three lines are own operated parking, 68 percent of revenue, contracted management, and consulting and installation of its PromptPark smart system with LPR cameras and cashless payment. It builds its own parking buildings, J Park Kanchanasuk opened 2024 and a 500 million baht Siriraj Salaya project with 1000 spaces opens 2026. FY2025 revenue was 576 million baht, net profit 83 million, founder Santipol holds 53 percent.

description: xlab-group.com Xlab Group is an Egyptian creative and technology holding founded in 2000 in Alexandria by Samer Mady and Emad Rafla, built on the mix of art and technology. It unites three companies, Xlab iT Solutions, Xlab Advertising with a 2000 square meter signage factory, and Xlab Software, plus studios for animation and video, with offices in Alexandria, Cairo Smart Village and Boston, USA. With about 72 employees and roughly 3.9 million dollars revenue, it has branded 2500 shops, produced 55000 square meters of outdoor signs, run 135 campaigns and managed 35 million dollars in online ad spending for 1650 clients. Blue chip clients include BASF, Orange, Schneider Electric and Marseilia Group, a partnership lasting over 10 years. Xlab Software builds its own products, an ERP suite, payroll, POS chain management and a shipping certificate system, plus 165 published websites. Recent growth focuses on Saudi Arabia real estate accounts like RAFAL and AkamAlrajhi and US market.

sportscity.com.tw sportscityvn.com Sports City International, SCI, is a Taiwanese sportswear manufacturer founded in 1988 in Taipei, headquartered in Neihu Science Park, and one of the top three garment makers for global athletic brands. Its clients include Nike, adidas, Under Armour, lululemon, The North Face, New Balance, REI and Gymshark, producing performance apparel, jackets, jerseys, yoga wear and down outerwear. From four people in a small office it has grown to over 35000 employees across 14 factories in Vietnam, the Philippines, Cambodia and China, with capital of NT165 million. Its Vietnam SNP plant is the group's first fully automated smart factory using IoT and real-time data, and Nike USA headquarters visited it in 2026 to review end to end automation. SCI is a hidden champion in World Cup and Olympics teamwear supply chains and even created the first NFT plus physical hoodie. It runs strong ESG programs, SBTi carbon targets, a 2040 carbon neutral blueprint.

rsms.com Red Sea Marine Services LLC is a ship management company based in Dubai, originally established in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia in 1987, serving the Bakri Group and major oil companies. Led by Managing Director Capt. Naushad Azad, it manages a fleet of crude, product and oil/chemical tankers plus LPG carriers, around 24 to 57 vessels and up to 2.4 million DWT, moving over 40 million tons of crude and fuel oil a year from Red Sea and Arabian Gulf terminals to worldwide destinations. The company was the first Saudi private firm certified to the ISM Code back in 1998 and holds ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 accreditation through ABS Group, with tankers routinely passing SIRE, CDI and TMSA audits. Services span ship management, STCW certified crew management, dry docking coordination, offshore support and port operations including the Yanbu port marine contract. It uses digital tools StratumFive and Viswa VEEMS for vessel tracking, energy efficiency and IMO compliance.

smithlifecommunities.org Charles E. Smith Life Communities is a nonprofit Jewish senior living organization founded in 1910, headquartered on a 38 acre campus in North Bethesda, Maryland. Led by CEO Bruce Lederman, it serves 1300 older adults a year, one of the largest single site senior campuses in the nation. Six residences cover the full continuum of care, Ring and Revitz House independent living, Landow House assisted living, Cohen-Rosen House memory care, and the Hebrew Home of Greater Washington, the largest nursing home in the mid Atlantic. The Warren R. Slavin center offers rehab with 30 plus therapists, Hirsh Health Center geriatric care, and SmithLife Homecare across Montgomery County. Rooted in Jewish values and open to all faiths, it runs the ElderSAFE Center against elder abuse. Finances are strong with 82.7 million revenue and 281 million assets in 2024, and Newsweek ranked its nursing home first in Maryland for 2025.

Innovation Industries, Inc. is a privately held US manufacturer headquartered at 3500 East Main Street, Russellville, Arkansas 72802. Founded in 1972, the company specialises in elevator fixtures, push buttons, controls, and accessories. It operates manufacturing facilities in Arkansas and through subsidiaries Virginia Controls, Inc. (VCI) in Virginia and Monitor Elevator Products (MEP). Additional entities include Innovation Aviation (corporate aviation) and 125 Ricefield (real estate holding). The company employs approximately 200-335 people and generates an estimated ~$100M in annual revenue, serving major elevator companies including Otis, KONE, and ThyssenKrupp. Paul Horney IV serves as President & CEO.

The exfiltrated dataset totals approximately 257 GB spanning 15 top-level directory trees from Windows file server network shares, capturing the company's entire digital footprint from 1997 through September 2026. The canonical filetree contains 751,853 entries.

<redacted>

Employee PII and HR Data. The HR share (3.6 GB) contains W-2 tax forms for all Innovation Industries, Virginia Controls, and Monitor Elevator employees from 2020 through 2025, exposing Social Security Numbers and wages for an estimated 300-500 individuals. Additional records include individual tax returns, I-9 immigration forms with citizenship status, benefits enrollment forms (BSI and CAS series) with SSN, date of birth, and dependent information, health insurance records, prescription cards, workers compensation injury data, 401(k) retirement records, personnel files, performance evaluations, disciplinary records, and at least one passport scan. Employee records span named individuals across 28+ VCI employee files and 34+ scanned personnel records.

Financial and MNPI. The dataset contains the company's complete financial history: audited financial statements from 1997 through 2018; monthly balance sheets and P&L statements from January 2017 through February 2024 for Innovation Industries, Innovation Aviation, and 125 Ricefield; board meeting packages with notes from 2012 through August 2026 (current year); subsidiary valuations including VCI working capital and valuation analysis; CARES Act PPP loan documents; 20+ years of accounts payable records (46 GB across 180-550+ vendor folders per year); bank reconciliation files for 8 separate bank accounts; and payroll budget worksheets. Vendor 1099 databases (2016-2020) contain Tax ID numbers for 250-1,000 vendors across all 50 states.

Manufacturing Intellectual Property. The dataset contains 27 GB of CNC machining programs encoding the complete manufacturing process for 2,400+ elevator fixture parts — representing 50+ years of accumulated manufacturing know-how. Additionally: 16 GB of engineering drawings, 1.7 GB of Haas CNC programs, 561 MB of laser cutting programs, RADAN sheet metal nesting data, and SolidWorks 3D design files. This material collectively enables a competitor to replicate Innovation Industries' entire product line.

Legal and Privileged Material. The Photo Eye product liability lawsuit directory contains insurance claim files, claim numbers, insurer correspondence, and lawsuit-related documents. Board meeting notes may contain privileged legal discussions. These files create privilege waiver risk under FRE 502(b).

IT and Infrastructure. Active Directory user exports (108 accounts), DHCP network topology, Postman API environment files revealing internal network endpoints (10.0.1.184:3001), and comprehensive server/backup documentation provide a complete map of the company's IT infrastructure.
